InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSCameraUsageDescri.source: ALAFIA uses your camera to photograph a meal, a medication label or a test strip so it can read them for you.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSCameraUsageDescri.translation: ALAFIA inatumia kamera yako kupiga picha ya chakula, lebo ya dawa au ukanda wa mtihani ili iweze kusoma kwa ajili yako.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSFaceIDUsageDescri.source: ALAFIA uses Face ID to lock and unlock your health information so only you can open the app.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSFaceIDUsageDescri.translation: ALAFIA inatumia Face ID kulinda na kufungua taarifa zako za afya ili wewe tu uweze kufungua programu.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthShareUsageD.source: ALAFIA reads your health data to provide personalized health insights, track fitness progress, and sync wellness information across your devices.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthShareUsageD.translation: ALAFIA inasoma data yako ya afya ili kutoa maarifa ya afya yanayofaa kwako, kufuatilia maendeleo ya fitness, na kusawazisha taarifa za wellness katika vifaa vyako.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthUpdateUsage.source: ALAFIA does not write data to Apple Health.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSHealthUpdateUsage.translation: ALAFIA haisomi data kwenye Apple Health.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSMicrophoneUsageDe.source: ALAFIA uses the microphone so you can speak your health logs and questions from the prompt page.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSMicrophoneUsageDe.translation: ALAFIA inatumia microphone ili uweze kusema kumbukumbu zako za afya na maswali kutoka ukurasa wa prompt.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSPhotoLibraryUsage.source: ALAFIA lets you attach a photo of a meal so it can estimate nutrition.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSPhotoLibraryUsage.translation: ALAFIA inakuruhusu kuambatanisha picha ya chakula ili iweze kukadiria virutubishi.

InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSSpeechRecognition.source: ALAFIA transcribes your speech on device to understand spoken health logs and questions.
InfoPlist.xcstrings::NSSpeechRecognition.translation: ALAFIA inabadilisha hotuba yako kwenye kifaa ili kuelewa kumbukumbu za afya na maswali yaliyosemwa.

Localizable.xcstrings::Upload a lab repo.source: Upload a lab report, medication list or flowsheet. Nothing is added to your records until you review it and choose Import.
Localizable.xcstrings::Upload a lab repo.translation: Pakia ripoti ya maabara, orodha ya dawa au karatasi. Hakuna kitu kinachojumlishwa kwenye rekodi zako hadi utakapokagua na kuchagua Ingiza.

Localizable.xcstrings::We sent a link to.source: We sent a link to %@. Open it, then come back and tap Continue.
Localizable.xcstrings::We sent a link to.translation: Tumetuma kiungo kwa %@. Fungua kiungo, kisha rudi na gusa Endelea.

Localizable.xcstrings::Weekly Minutes Ta.translation: Lengo la Dakika za Kila Wiki

Localizable.xcstrings::What are you grat.source: What are you grateful for today?

Localizable.xcstrings::Where health info.translation: Mahali ambapo taarifa za afya zinatoka

Localizable.xcstrings::You are never ide.source: You are never identified to an AI provider

Localizable.xcstrings::You regularly log.source: You regularly log %1$lld medication%2$@ that aren’t on this list
Localizable.xcstrings::You regularly log.translation: Unarekodia kila mara %1$lld dawa%2$@ ambazo hazipo kwenye orodha hii

Localizable.xcstrings::Your current pass.source: Your current password keeps working until you do.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your current pass.translation: Neno lako la siri la sasa litaendelea kufanya kazi hadi utabadilishe.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your data is prot.source: Your data is protected according to applicable healthcare privacy regulations.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your data is prot.translation: Data yako inalindwa kulingana na sheria za faragha za huduma za afya.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your lab results.source: Your lab results will appear here as charts once data is available.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your lab results.translation: Matokeo yako ya maabara yataonekana hapa kama chati mara data inapokuwa inapatikana.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your limits are u.source: Your limits are unchanged — they already assume your usual treatment. What changes is the day's balance.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your limits are u.translation: Mipaka yako haibadiliki — tayari inachukulia matibabu yako ya kawaida. Kinachobadilika ni usawa wa siku.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your own health r.source: Your own health record, meals and tracking live in the patient view.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your own health r.translation: Rekodi yako ya afya, chakula na ufuatiliaji wako wanaishi katika mtazamo wa mgonjwa.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your session expi.source: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your session expi.translation: Kikao chako kimekoma. Tafadhali ingia tena.

Localizable.xcstrings::Your wellness sco.source: Your wellness score will appear here once calculated.
Localizable.xcstrings::Your wellness sco.translation: Alama yako ya afya itaonekana hapa mara itakapohesabiwa.

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. I ate jollof.source: e.g. I ate jollof rice and took my 10mg lisinopril
Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. I ate jollof.translation: k.m. Niliula jollof rice na kuchukua lisinopril 10mg yangu

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. bad knees, l.source: e.g. bad knees, lower back pain
Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. bad knees, l.translation: k.m. magoti mabaya, maumivu ya mgongo wa chini

Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. beans in pal.source: e.g. beans in palm oil; grilled chicken
Localizable.xcstrings::e.g. beans in pal.translation: k.m. maharagwe katika mafuta ya palamu; kuku kilichokaangwa

Localizable.xcstrings::↑ aim for · ↓ sta.source: ↑ aim for · ↓ stay under. Guidance from your biology & conditions — not medical advice.
Localizable.xcstrings::↑ aim for · ↓ sta.translation: ↑ jaribu · ↓ kaa chini. Mwongozo kutoka kwa biolojia yako & hali — si ushauri wa kimatibabu.
